characters.name: Meilin Lee
characters.description: A confident and hard-working 13-year-old girl in Toronto who suddenly turns into a giant red panda when she gets too excited.

characters.name: Ming Lee
characters.description: Meilin's loving but overprotective mom who is always nearby and has her own red panda secret.

characters.name: Miriam
characters.description: Meilin's cheerful and supportive best friend who thinks the red panda transformation is totally awesome.

characters.name: Abby
characters.description: A wild and energetic friend of Meilin who loves to cheer her on no matter what happens.

translations.title: Turning Red (2022)
translations.description: A 13-year-old girl in Toronto discovers that whenever she gets too excited or emotional, she transforms into a giant fluffy red panda.
translations.history: Turning Red is set in Toronto, Canada in 2002, and the movie celebrates Chinese-Canadian culture and the fun pop music of that era!

translations.title: Chuyển Biến Đỏ (2022)
translations.description: Một cô bé 13 tuổi ở Toronto phát hiện ra rằng mỗi khi cô quá kích động hoặc cảm xúc quá mạnh, cô sẽ biến thành một chú gấu trúc đỏ khổng lồ.
translations.history: Turning Red được đặt ở Toronto, Canada năm 2002, và bộ phim tôn vinh văn hóa Canada gốc Trung Hoa và âm nhạc pop vui tươi của thời đó!
